option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: unzip -o webHelpD2-all.zip -d webHelpD2-all && rm -rf webHelpD2-all/api-docs && if [ -d ../dokka/html ]; then cp -r ../dokka/html webHelpD2-all/api-docs && perl -pi -e 's#https://kotlin.github.io/dataframe/api-docs/#api-docs/#g' webHelpD2-all/*.html; else echo 'No Dokka output in build/dokka/html, run Build Dokka API Docs first to include the API reference.'; fi && cd webHelpD2-all && python3 -m http.server 8000

option.name: SCRIPT_OPTIONS
